title: Integral Laurent model for split tori
statement: Let $r\in\mathbf N$. Put $L_r=\mathbf Z[\mathbf Z^r]$, the commutative group algebra of the additive group $\mathbf Z^r$, with basis $e_v$ and $e_ve_w=e_{v+w}$. Give $L_r$ the Hopf structure $e_v\mapsto e_v\otimes e_v$, $e_v\mapsto1$, and $e_v\mapsto e_{-v}$. Its spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is the commutative group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme] $T_{\mathbf Z,r}$ over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$. For any scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], define the integral-model split torus $T_{S,r}$ to be the base change $T_{\mathbf Z,r}\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}S$ [def-pc-fibre-product] along the unique map $S\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$, with the pulled-back group law and the fixed Laurent coordinates indexed by the standard basis of $\mathbf Z^r$. Rank zero is included.
